# `aitbc trade history`

Show the history of inter-chain trades between source and destination chains.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade history [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--source-chain` | text | — | no | Filter by source chain |
| `--dest-chain` | text | — | no | Filter by destination chain |
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max results |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade history
```
